name: What documents do I need to prepare before getting a valuation for my luxury condo?

mainEntity.name: What documents do I need to prepare before getting a valuation for my luxury condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before a valuation, gather documents that provide a comprehensive overview of your luxury condo. This includes your property's deed, recent property tax statements, any HOA/condo association documents (bylaws, financial statements, master insurance policy), and a list of all recent upgrades or renovations with associated costs. Providing floor plans, a detailed list of amenities, and utility bills can also be helpful. This preparation ensures that the valuer has all necessary information to accurately assess your property's worth and potential in areas like West Palm Beach or Doral.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare your deed, tax statements, HOA documents, renovation records, floor plans, amenity lists, and utility bills for an accurate luxury condo valuation.
